author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಣಮುಖ್ಯವಾದೊಡನೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ನಶಿಸುವುದು
ಗುಣಧನಕೆ ಪರಿಧಿಯಿರೆ ಸುಂದರವೆ ಬದುಕು
ಗುಣಿಸುತಿರೆ ಗುಣನಡತೆ ಹಣವುಜತೆಗೂಡುವುದು
ಗುಣಿಯಾಗು ಬದುಕಿಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When money becomes the main thing, life itself perishes;
when wealth of character is bounded, life is beautiful;
if you keep multiplying virtue and conduct, money comes along too;
be virtuous; that is where life is, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Money-first living destroys life. Grow in character and good conduct, and wealth follows naturally. Virtue is where true life lies.
